objective: Prove the Phase 0 two-machine, one-lab handoff MVP before enabling multi-lab behavior.

tasks.title: Run receiving-machine bootstrap to READY
completion_criteria: Every WARN or FAIL is resolved or documented without exposing secrets

tasks.title: Verify one-lab coordination on two machines
completion_criteria: Lease claim, renew, release, denial, and expiry behavior are verified during an idle or handed-off window
Git and Convex converge without browser, manifest, ledger, or site-state collisions

tasks.title: Verify Codex orchestrator portability
completion_criteria: Fresh Codex session resumes from repository instructions alone
Claude-only assumptions are absent or explicitly mapped
Host capability gaps are recorded honestly
evidence: macOS launchd and gstack browser dependencies made explicit
Codex host is mapped as its own INT reviewer

tasks.title: Close bootstrap prerequisite-detection gaps
completion_criteria: TinyTeX pdflatex is detected or its degraded state is documented
No prerequisite check is weakened to force READY
evidence: BigBounce env-key audit has zero missing key names
isolated lease CAS + cron routing test passes

blockers.title: Live M41 owns browser and manifest
blockers.clear_when: M41 is idle or explicitly hands off browser and ledger ownership

blockers.title: Hubify CLI unauthenticated
blockers.clear_when: Hubify authentication succeeds and lab/status claims can be queried

blockers.title: Machine-sync shared repo dirty or conflicted
blockers.clear_when: Shared-repo ownership is reconciled and sync can run without overwriting work

completed.title: Verify handoff commits are reachable and pushed
Verify lease and heartbeat files exist

mvp_completion_criteria: Second machine reaches bootstrap READY without secret exposure
Lease and heartbeat behavior is verified during an explicit idle or handoff window
Both machines converge on the same git and Convex state without write collisions
Codex resumes from repository instructions alone
Houston accepts the two-machine one-lab workflow

gated_phases.title: Two blind labs on bounded P4 mirror-flip reproduction
gated_phases.entry_gate: Phase 1 green; seal/reveal tooling tested; Convex labId and site support landed

watchpoints: Do not implement multi-lab schema, site, branches, or seal/reveal during Phase 0.
Only the lease holder may drive browser, verdict, or ledger writes.
Do not modify M41 manifest, prompts.md, SSOT, or generated .agents skills in this lane.
